description: Government recognition for eligible startups under the Startup India initiative.
benefits: Access to specified Startup India benefits and scheme opportunities, subject to each benefit's rules.
eligibility: Must satisfy the current DPIIT definition of a startup, including entity, age, turnover and innovation criteria.
application_process: Apply through the official Startup India portal and submit required entity and business details.

description: Seed-stage support routed through selected incubators for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry and commercialisation.
benefits: Eligible startups may receive grant or debt/convertible support under scheme conditions.
eligibility: Scheme-specific conditions apply, including incorporation age, DPIIT recognition and Indian promoter shareholding requirements.
application_process: Check current scheme status and apply through an eligible incubator listed on the official portal.

description: Government fund-of-funds managed through SIDBI that commits capital to eligible SEBI-registered AIFs.
benefits: AIFs supported by the fund may invest in startups; this is not a direct government grant to a startup.
eligibility: Startup must meet the investment criteria of an AIF participating in the ecosystem.
application_process: Identify participating AIFs and approach them directly with a pitch and due-diligence documents.

description: Credit-guarantee framework intended to encourage eligible lenders to provide debt to eligible startups.
benefits: Guarantee cover to eligible lending institutions; it does not mean an automatic grant or loan approval.
eligibility: DPIIT-recognised startup and lender-level eligibility, exposure and guarantee conditions apply.
funding_amount: Loan amount and guarantee cover subject to current scheme rules
application_process: Approach a participating member institution and ask whether the proposed loan can be covered under CGSS.

description: Startup India platform intended to connect startups with mentors across business functions and sectors.
benefits: Mentorship, guidance and ecosystem connections; not direct funding.
eligibility: Registration and participation conditions on the portal apply.
application_process: Register or explore mentor options through the Startup India portal.

description: Platform intended to facilitate connections between startups and investors.
benefits: Potential investor discovery and fundraising connections; no guaranteed investment.
eligibility: Startup profile and platform onboarding requirements apply.
application_process: Create or update the startup profile and follow the current platform onboarding process.

description: Facilitation support for eligible startups seeking patents, trademarks and designs.
benefits: Access to facilitators and applicable fee rebates or expedited processing under current rules.
eligibility: Eligibility and facilitator/fee conditions must be checked for the relevant IP application.
application_process: Use the Startup India IPR support information and follow the relevant IP office filing process.

description: Eligible startups may self-certify compliance with specified labour and environmental laws under applicable rules.
benefits: Reduced inspection burden for covered laws, subject to conditions and exclusions.
eligibility: Only specified laws and eligible startups are covered; all other legal obligations continue.
application_process: Review the current Startup India self-certification guidance and complete required portal declarations.

description: Certain government procurement rules provide eligible startups relaxations from prior experience or turnover requirements.
benefits: Potential access to government tenders where the procuring authority permits the relaxation.
eligibility: Tender-specific conditions, quality and technical requirements continue to apply.
application_process: Search GeM and department tender notices; verify the specific tender's startup provisions.

description: Tax deduction provision for qualifying eligible startups under the Income-tax law, subject to approval and statutory conditions.
benefits: Potential deduction of eligible profits for the permitted period if all conditions are met.
eligibility: Incorporation date, DPIIT recognition, approval and other statutory conditions apply; verify current law and deadlines.
entity_type: Eligible company or LLP as prescribed by law
application_process: Consult a chartered accountant and check the current Income Tax Department and Startup India requirements.

scheme_name: Maharashtra Startup, Entrepreneurship and Innovation Policy 2025
description: State policy framework for strengthening entrepreneurship, innovation, startup support and ecosystem development.
benefits: May provide or enable state-level support; exact incentives depend on notified implementation rules and eligibility.
eligibility: Depends on the specific policy provision, notification and applicant profile.
application_process: Read the policy and current government resolutions; contact the Maharashtra State Innovation Society for programme details.

scheme_name: Maharashtra Innovation and Technological Development Fund (MITDF)
description: State fund intended to support innovation and technology development through investment mechanisms.
benefits: Potential equity or equity-linked investment, subject to fund availability, appraisal and terms.
eligibility: Maharashtra connection, innovation, scalability and fund-specific due diligence requirements apply.
application_process: Check the official Maharashtra scheme page and contact the implementing department for current application details.

description: State nodal organisation supporting innovation, entrepreneurship and startup ecosystem programmes in Maharashtra.
benefits: Information about state programmes, ecosystem initiatives, events and support channels.
eligibility: Programme-specific eligibility applies.
application_process: Explore current programmes, notices and contact information on the official MSInS website.

description: Incubators and ecosystem partners provide mentoring, workspace, business support and access to networks.
benefits: Incubation services and possible introductions to grants, investors or technical facilities; support varies by incubator.
eligibility: Each incubator has its own sector, stage, location and selection criteria.
application_process: Find an appropriate incubator through MSInS or recognised institutional incubator directories and apply to its programme.

description: A dataset entry to track individual incentives announced under Maharashtra startup policy or government resolutions.
benefits: Potential reimbursements, grants or other support only where a current notification explicitly provides them.
eligibility: Must be assessed against the exact government resolution, applicant category, location and application window.
application_process: Do not apply using this generic entry; locate the specific current government resolution and implementing agency.

description: A company incorporated under the Companies Act with separate legal identity and limited liability for shareholders.
benefits: Often suitable for startups planning equity investment, ESOPs and scalable ownership structures.
eligibility: At least the statutory minimum number of members and directors; comply with current company law requirements.
application_process: Incorporate through the Ministry of Corporate Affairs portal with professional advice where needed.

description: A partnership structure with separate legal identity and limited liability, governed by the LLP Act.
benefits: Flexible internal management and limited liability; equity fundraising structure differs from a company.
eligibility: At least the statutory minimum number of partners and designated partners; comply with LLP law.
application_process: Register through the Ministry of Corporate Affairs portal and review tax and compliance implications.

description: A partnership business registered under applicable partnership law; partners share responsibilities and liabilities.
benefits: Simple ownership arrangement, but partners may have personal liability and fundraising limitations.
eligibility: Two or more partners and a partnership deed; registration and state requirements should be checked.
recognition_required: DPIIT recognition eligibility differs; verify current rules
application_process: Prepare a partnership deed and complete registration and tax formalities with professional guidance.

description: Online learning resource covering startup fundamentals such as business planning, finance, legal basics and growth.
benefits: Entrepreneurship learning and foundational guidance; not direct funding.
eligibility: Check current course availability and enrolment requirements.
recognition_required: No general recognition requirement for learning
application_process: Visit the Startup India portal and check available learning resources.

description: GeM initiative intended to provide startups a route to showcase innovative products and services to government buyers.
benefits: Potential visibility and government market access; no guarantee of orders or contracts.
eligibility: Seller registration, product/service category and procurement-specific requirements apply.
application_process: Register as a seller on GeM and review current Startup Runway and bid requirements.
